title.zh: 在奎松省设立两个学校分区的法案
title.en: An Act to Provide for Two School Divisions in the Province of Quezon
title.orig: An Act to Provide for Two School Divisions in the Province of Quezon

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1961/ra_3400_1961.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be two school divisions in the Province of Quezon, one shall include all the municipalities of the Subprovince of Aurora, including the Municipal District of Dingalan. The permanent station of the Superintendent of Schools of this division shall be in the Municipality of Baler. The other division shall include all the rest of the municipalities of the province. The permanent station of the Superintendent of Schools of this division shall be in the Municipality of Lucena.

The Director of Public Schools shall reorganize the School Division of the Province of Quezon into two schools division commencing with the school year 1961-1962, in accordance with the provisions of this Act.

Such sums as may be necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act for the school year 1961-1962 is hereby authorized, to be appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated. The sum necessary for the same purpose in subsequent school years shall be included in the General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1961.
